title: Understanding Managers' Trade-offs between Exploration and Exploitation
eligible_reason: Not a DiD. Hierarchical Bayesian EEI/EWA learning model of managers' exploration and exploitation in business-simulation (bandit) experiments, with simulations and out-of-sample prediction.
design_notes: codes/Study1_analysis.R, Study2_analysis_two_business_sims.R, Study3_analysis_time_horison.R (Stan estimation), Simulation_study.R, Counterfactual_simulation_study.R; regressions in the inventory are parameter-recovery and switching logits.
data_files: datasets/businessTask_Study1.csv and other study files, priors and counterfactual inputs
data_files_note: Experimental data from the business-simulation studies shipped.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text/mksc and papers/mksc checked Nov 2); the OpenAlex abstract in data/frame/mksc.jsonl is a one-sentence summary. Design read from the README and the main-results code; no package code was run.
